overview:
Use case: web-app-mockup. Create a polished full-page CUSTOMER travel account UI for AzərTur, an inbound Azerbaijan travel company. This is the customer's personal area, not the office/admin dashboard. Input image 1 is the approved trip planner style reference. Input image 2 is the approved tour detail reference. Follow their actual warm off-white #faf8f4, charcoal, forest green, pale sage, restrained flat orange, crisp Manrope-like typography, fine dividers, generous spacing and small corner radii. Reuse the same sunny stone mountain village and mountains imagery, not new unrelated travel photos. Orange A logo with black "azərtur". NO pill badges, eyebrow text, neon, gradients, shadows everywhere, fake analytics, statistics tiles, charts, AI chat, glassmorphism, device mockups or browser chrome. Status must be ordinary text with a small outlined clock icon. Render exact readable English copy and arithmetic. Complete page including real bottom/footer; do not truncate. Full-width 1440px desktop layout shown straight on, high fidelity, content-rich but calm. Global site navigation: logo, Tours, Destinations, Create your trip, About us, EN, EUR, My account. Footer forest green with logo, Explore, Company, Information links. Sample data only. Nothing is booked or paid in this pending request. Contract and staged payments are planned and not represented as already available.
Primary request: Design the COMPLETE My trips overview page, clearly different from the trip detail page. Below navbar, two-column personal-account layout: a restrained 210px text sidebar with "My trips" active (orange underline), "Account details" and bottom "Sign out"; no dark admin sidebar. Main content starts "Your journeys." with short subtitle "Your Azerbaijan plans, all in one place." and a quiet "Plan another trip →" button upper right. A simple thin-underlined filter row "All trips (1)" selected, "Upcoming", "Past"; search unnecessary for one trip. One generous horizontal editorial request entry, NOT grid cards. Left 38% beautiful landscape photo from approved highland village. Right request number "42bf2845", title "Your custom journey", route "Quba → Khinalug", "15–16 May 2027 · 2 days · 2 travelers"; plain status "Waiting for operator review". A pale sage inset shows "Your request is with our team." and "We’re checking the route and availability. No payment is due." Beneath a fine divider, "Estimated group total €495" with smaller "Paid €0 · Remaining €495", primary modest orange "View request →". No Pay now button. Beneath entry, section "What happens next?" with three simple horizontal numbered text columns: "1. Team review" / "We check availability and prepare your offer."; "2. Your confirmed offer" / "Review the itinerary, final prices and terms."; "3. Contract & payments" / "After contract approval, a deposit and later service payments follow." Footnote "Contract approval and staged payments are planned. Current payments are simulated." At bottom an understated two-column account/help strip: "Need to update your plan?" / "Open your request to send a change or cancellation." and "Your account" / "Alex Morgan" / "alex@example.com" / "EN · English". Avoid full personal profile editing controls. One example trip only. Suitable complete artboard approximately 1440×1450; no excessive blank space, no repeated version panels.

Reuse the same sunny stone mountain village and mountains imagery, not new unrelated travel photos. Orange A logo with black "azərtur". NO pill badges, eyebrow text, neon, gradients, shadows everywhere, fake analytics, statistics tiles, charts, AI chat, glassmorphism, device mockups or browser chrome. Full-width 1440px desktop layout shown straight on, high fidelity, content-rich but calm. Global site navigation: logo, Tours, Destinations, Create your trip, About us, EN, EUR, My account. Primary request: Design the COMPLETE customer REQUEST DETAIL page. This must be a different page from overview, with no trip-card list. Under navbar breadcrumb "My trips / Request 42bf2845", link "← Back to my trips", heading "Your custom journey", meta "15–16 May 2027 · 2 days · 1 night · 2 travelers". A wide but shallow cinematic mountain-village photo 200px tall. Under it pale sage full-width status notice with clock and "Waiting for operator review" and "We’re checking your route and availability. No payment is due." Then desktop main content 2/3 left and sticky-feeling 1/3 right. Left has anchor tabs "Overview", "Services", "Requests", "Documents". "Your route" contains two nicely detailed day rows with small day numbers (not pills), Day 1 · Quba / Scenic stops on the road north; Day 2 · Khinalug / Village paths and mountain scenery; thin route Baku → Quba → Khinalug, note "Return route arranged with our team." No fake map/times. "Your selected services" five tidy rows with Lucide-like line icons, independent unit math and exact totals: Private car & driver / 2 days × €90 / €180; Comfort stay / 1 room × 1 night × €110 / €110; English-speaking guide / 2 days × €65 / €130; Airport transfer / 1 transfer × €35 / €35; Local craft experience / 2 travelers × €20 / €40. Fine divider total €495. "Your notes" short sample "A relaxed pace, with time for village walks." "Requests & updates" empty state "No change or cancellation requests yet." and outlined "Request a change or cancellation →". Below small note "The team reviews every request. Terms and refunds depend on the service, provider and cancellation time." A "Documents" section with one muted outlined document icon and "No documents yet" / "Your confirmed offer and documents will appear here when available." No fake downloadable PDF. Right summary heading "Your request" number42bf2845, two-col values "Estimated total €495", "Paid €0", "Remaining €495"; sample pricing qualifier "Final services and price confirmed by our team." Under divider "Next step" / "Wait for our team’s review." No pay or accept contract buttons. Under summary simple "How payments will work" explanatory copy "Review the confirmed offer and PDF contract before a deposit. Later payments follow confirmed service requests." smaller "Contract approval and staged payments are planned. Current payments are simulated." Full footer. Approx 1440×2200 artboard, spacious hierarchy, avoid tiny text.
